scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.type-check: npm run build -w shared && npm run type-check -w client && npm run build:check -w server
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w client && npx cap sync android --prefix client
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android --prefix client
